newsitem.title: USA: Belmont, Cavalier in merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Belmont, Cavalier in merger pact.

text.p: Belmont Homes Inc said Thursday it executed a definitive agreement to merge with a subsidiary of Cavalier Homes Inc.
The agreement calls for the exchange of 0.80 share of Cavalier for each outstanding share of Belmont stock.
Cavalier would issue about 7.6 million shares of common stock in the deal.
The agreement also calls for the election of two Belmont directors to Cavalier's board.
Barry Donnell would remain chairman of Cavalier, and David Roberson would remain its president and chief executive.
Cavalier's executive offices would remain in Addison, Ala. Belmont would become a subsidiary of Cavalier, and its headquarters would remain in Belmont, Mississippi.

The company said the combination is intended to qualify as a tax-free exchange to its shareholders and to be accounted for as a pooling of interests. It is subject to shareholder approval at both companies.
Belmont said it expects the deal to close within four months.
